title: Login panel: is-it-safe explainer, account-opening link, no-extra-charges line (row 2 gap G-02-1)
reference_behaviour: The login page has one large broker login button, an account-opening link for users without a broker account, a link asking whether logging in with the broker is safe, and a line saying there are no extra charges beyond normal brokerage.
reference_label: Is it safe to login with my broker?
ours: Only a Connect Zerodha link in Settings and the server prompt; no explainer, no account link. ADR-175 decided to add both (link with the partner code); Built in 172f1f18 (AC-11).
